title: 德基水庫大壩
summary: 德基課程把高拱壩、岩盤差異位移與大甲溪梯級發電放在共同的能量與量測架構中。跨流域水量、密度底流、管壁環向應力與水錘傳播各有不同邊界，不能只靠一個水頭數字判斷。最後以停機水量帳和儀器取樣問題檢查發電估算是否保持物理一致。
summaryEn: The Deji course connects a high arch dam, differential rock movement and cascading generation through energy and measurement. Diversion water balance, density underflows, pipe hoop stress and water-hammer travel each require distinct boundaries rather than a single head value. Outage accounting and instrument sampling then test whether an energy estimate remains physically consistent.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「梯級發電的能量相加」與「高壩底壓與水推力」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Energy addition across a cascade" and "Base pressure and water resultant": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 梯級發電的能量相加：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Energy addition across a cascade: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「梯級發電的能量相加」如何影響德基水庫大壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Energy addition across a cascade” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Deji Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 大甲溪梯級背景讓同一股水在不同高程依序釋放位能，每級只能利用其邊界內的淨水頭。功率應逐級計算再相加，不能把同一股串聯流量先相加又乘總落差。若中間有旁通、蓄水或取水，各級流量也未必相同，能量帳必須跟著水量控制體分段，並保留尾水與上游基準高程。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「梯級發電的能量相加」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: In a cascade, the same water releases potential energy at successive elevations, with each stage using only the net head within its boundary. Stage powers are calculated separately and added; adding the same serial flow first and multiplying by combined head double counts water. Bypass, storage and withdrawals can also make stage flows differ, requiring separate water accounts and explicit upstream and tailwater elevation references. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Energy addition across a cascade” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; Q=15 m3/s; H1=200 m; H2=120 m; eta1=0.9; eta2=0.88; P=rho g Q(H1 eta1+H2 eta2)/1e6=42.02604 MW。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; Q=15 m3/s; H1=200 m; H2=120 m; eta1=0.9; eta2=0.88; P=rho g Q(H1 eta1+H2 eta2)/1e6=42.02604 MW.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「串聯兩級流量應先相加再乘上總水頭」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Serial stage discharges should be added before multiplying by total head" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「梯級發電的能量相加」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Energy addition across a cascade”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

options: 串聯兩級流量應先相加再乘上總水頭
大甲溪梯級背景讓同一股水在不同高程依序釋放位能，每級只能利用其邊界內的淨水頭。

optionsEn: Serial stage discharges should be added before multiplying by total head
In a cascade, the same water releases potential energy at successive elevations, with each stage using only the net head within its boundary.
Structural dam height is the hydrostatic depth at every reservoir level
quiz.explanation: 大甲溪梯級背景讓同一股水在不同高程依序釋放位能，每級只能利用其邊界內的淨水頭。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: In a cascade, the same water releases potential energy at successive elevations, with each stage using only the net head within its boundary. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 梯級發電的能量相加：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Energy addition across a cascade: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「梯級發電的能量相加」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Energy addition across a cascade” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; Q=15 m3/s; H1=200 m; H2=120 m; eta1=0.9; eta2=0.88; P=rho g Q(H1 eta1+H2 eta2)/1e6=42.02604 MW。適用邊界：兩級相同穩定流量且水頭為各級淨值，未使用德基實際機組參數。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; Q=15 m3/s; H1=200 m; H2=120 m; eta1=0.9; eta2=0.88; P=rho g Q(H1 eta1+H2 eta2)/1e6=42.02604 MW. Applicable boundary: Two stages share constant flow and stage-specific net heads; no actual Deji machine parameters are used. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：分別畫每級進出口能量線，檢查中間尾水是否也是下一級上游基準。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Draw inlet and outlet energy lines for each stage and check how intermediate tailwater connects to the next inlet.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 梯級發電的能量相加：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Energy addition across a cascade: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「梯級發電的能量相加」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Energy addition across a cascade” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 分別畫每級進出口能量線，檢查中間尾水是否也是下一級上游基準。以各級電表與同時段流量比對，將中間蓄水變化另外入帳，再核對總電能沒有超過共同水流的可用位能。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Draw inlet and outlet energy lines for each stage and check how intermediate tailwater connects to the next inlet. Compare stage electrical meters with synchronized flow, account separately for intermediate storage and verify that total energy stays below the water's available potential. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將第二級效率降至零點八，重算總功率與差額，再設中間暫存使第二級流量少三立方公尺每秒，分開求能量與蓄量變化而不混算。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Lower second-stage efficiency to zero point eight and recalculate total power. Then reduce its flow by three cubic metres per second through intermediate storage, calculating energy and storage changes in separate accounts.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把兩級流量相加後再乘總水頭會重複計入同一水體；若中間水庫正在蓄水卻仍假設流量立即一致，則會錯配發電時間，讓逐時能量帳失去守恆。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Adding serial discharges and multiplying by combined head counts the same water twice. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 分別畫每級進出口能量線，檢查中間尾水是否也是下一級上游基準。以各級電表與同時段流量比對，將中間蓄水變化另外入帳，再核對總電能沒有超過共同水流的可用位能。
knowledge.textEn: Draw inlet and outlet energy lines for each stage and check how intermediate tailwater connects to the next inlet. Compare stage electrical meters with synchronized flow, account separately for intermediate storage and verify that total energy stays below the water's available potential.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將第二級效率降至零點八，重算總功率與差額，再設中間暫存使第二級流量少三立方公尺每秒，分開求能量與蓄量變化而不混算。
knowledge.textEn: Lower second-stage efficiency to zero point eight and recalculate total power. Then reduce its flow by three cubic metres per second through intermediate storage, calculating energy and storage changes in separate accounts.

quiz.question: 要驗證「梯級發電的能量相加」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Energy addition across a cascade"?
options: 分別畫每級進出口能量線，檢查中間尾水是否也是下一級上游基準。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
壓力波傳播速度就是管內水的平均流速
optionsEn: Draw inlet and outlet energy lines for each stage and check how intermediate tailwater connects to the next inlet.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Pressure-wave speed equals the mean velocity of water in the pipe
quiz.explanation: 分別畫每級進出口能量線，檢查中間尾水是否也是下一級上游基準。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Draw inlet and outlet energy lines for each stage and check how intermediate tailwater connects to the next inlet. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 梯級發電的能量相加：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Energy addition across a cascade: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「梯級發電的能量相加」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Energy addition across a cascade” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把兩級流量相加後再乘總水頭會重複計入同一水體；若中間水庫正在蓄水卻仍假設流量立即一致，則會錯配發電時間，讓逐時能量帳失去守恆。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Adding serial discharges and multiplying by combined head counts the same water twice. Assuming immediate equal flow while an intermediate reservoir is storing water also shifts generation to the wrong time and breaks hourly accounting. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若中間有旁通、蓄水或取水，各級流量也未必相同，能量帳必須跟著水量控制體分段，並保留尾水與上游基準高程。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Bypass, storage and withdrawals can also make stage flows differ, requiring separate water accounts and explicit upstream and tailwater elevation references.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「串聯兩級流量應先相加再乘上總水頭」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Serial stage discharges should be added before multiplying by total head" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把兩級流量相加後再乘總水頭會重複計入同一水體；若中間水庫正在蓄水卻仍假設流量立即一致，則會錯配發電時間，讓逐時能量帳失去守恆。
knowledge.textEn: Adding serial discharges and multiplying by combined head counts the same water twice. Assuming immediate equal flow while an intermediate reservoir is storing water also shifts generation to the wrong time and breaks hourly accounting.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「梯級發電的能量相加」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Energy addition across a cascade" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
把兩級流量相加後再乘總水頭會重複計入同一水體；若中間水庫正在蓄水卻仍假設流量立即一致，則會錯配發電時間，讓逐時能量帳失去守恆。
壩高就是任何水位下都應使用的靜水深度
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Adding serial discharges and multiplying by combined head counts the same water twice.
Structural dam height is the hydrostatic depth at every reservoir level
quiz.explanation: 把兩級流量相加後再乘總水頭會重複計入同一水體；若中間水庫正在蓄水卻仍假設流量立即一致，則會錯配發電時間，讓逐時能量帳失去守恆。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Adding serial discharges and multiplying by combined head counts the same water twice. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.objective: 說明「高壩底壓與水推力」如何影響德基水庫大壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Base pressure and water resultant” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Deji Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 德基高拱壩背景可用來區分局部壓力與整體水推力：底部靜水壓隨水深一次增加，但固定寬度投影上的合力隨深度平方增加。壓力的單位是力除面積，而合力才可進入整體受力平衡。水深應由自由水面量到計算點，不能直接把壩高當成每一時刻的有效水深，也不能忽略尾水反壓。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「高壩底壓與水推力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A high arch dam illustrates the difference between local pressure and integrated water force. Bottom hydrostatic pressure increases linearly with depth, while force on a fixed-width projection grows with depth squared. Pressure is force per area, whereas the resultant enters overall equilibrium. Depth is measured from the free surface to the point, not automatically equated with structural height, and downstream counterpressure must be considered when relevant. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Base pressure and water resultant” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; H=140 m; pbase=rho g H/1e6=1.3734 MPa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; H=140 m; pbase=rho g H/1e6=1.3734 MPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「壩高就是任何水位下都應使用的靜水深度」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Structural dam height is the hydrostatic depth at every reservoir level" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「高壩底壓與水推力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Base pressure and water resultant”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 高壩底壓與水推力
knowledge.text: 德基高拱壩背景可用來區分局部壓力與整體水推力：底部靜水壓隨水深一次增加，但固定寬度投影上的合力隨深度平方增加。壓力的單位是力除面積，而合力才可進入整體受力平衡。
knowledge.textEn: A high arch dam illustrates the difference between local pressure and integrated water force. Bottom hydrostatic pressure increases linearly with depth, while force on a fixed-width projection grows with depth squared.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：壩高就是任何水位下都應使用的靜水深度 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Structural dam height is the hydrostatic depth at every reservoir level Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「高壩底壓與水推力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Base pressure and water resultant" is correct?
options: 壩高就是任何水位下都應使用的靜水深度
兩岸同向等量平移必然造成跨距增加
德基高拱壩背景可用來區分局部壓力與整體水推力：底部靜水壓隨水深一次增加，但固定寬度投影上的合力隨深度平方增加。
optionsEn: Structural dam height is the hydrostatic depth at every reservoir level
Equal translation of both abutments in one direction necessarily increases span
A high arch dam illustrates the difference between local pressure and integrated water force.
quiz.explanation: 德基高拱壩背景可用來區分局部壓力與整體水推力：底部靜水壓隨水深一次增加，但固定寬度投影上的合力隨深度平方增加。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A high arch dam illustrates the difference between local pressure and integrated water force. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 高壩底壓與水推力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Base pressure and water resultant: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「高壩底壓與水推力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Base pressure and water resultant” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; H=140 m; pbase=rho g H/1e6=1.3734 MPa。適用邊界：靜止淡水的表壓，水深為假想值而非公開壩高或當前水位。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; H=140 m; pbase=rho g H/1e6=1.3734 MPa. Applicable boundary: Gauge pressure in still fresh water, with hypothetical depth rather than dam height or current reservoir level. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用壓力三角形區分底壓與平均壓，再選一個投影寬度求合力以確認單位不同。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use a pressure triangle to separate bottom and mean pressures, then select a projected width to obtain force and check units.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; H=140 m; pbase=rho g H/1e6=1.3734 MPa。適用邊界：靜止淡水的表壓，水深為假想值而非公開壩高或當前水位。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; H=140 m; pbase=rho g H/1e6=1.3734 MPa. Applicable boundary: Gauge pressure in still fresh water, with hypothetical depth rather than dam height or current reservoir level.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「高壩底壓與水推力」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Base pressure and water resultant", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; H=140 m; pbase=rho g H/1e6=1.3734 MPa。
跨流域水量可在來源與目的地總帳各算一次供水
受拉薄壁管公式可直接證明受壓拱壩安全
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; H=140 m; pbase=rho g H/1e6=1.3734 MPa.
Transferred water may count as new system supply at both source and destination
A tensile thin-pipe equation directly proves the safety of a compressed arch dam
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; H=140 m; pbase=rho g H/1e6=1.3734 MPa。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; H=140 m; pbase=rho g H/1e6=1.3734 MPa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 高壩底壓與水推力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Base pressure and water resultant: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「高壩底壓與水推力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Base pressure and water resultant” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用壓力三角形區分底壓與平均壓，再選一個投影寬度求合力以確認單位不同。核對壓力感測器是絕對壓還是表壓，並將安裝高程與水面高程分開記錄，避免基準錯置。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use a pressure triangle to separate bottom and mean pressures, then select a projected width to obtain force and check units. Identify absolute versus gauge pressure sensors and record installation and water-surface elevations separately to prevent datum errors. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：把假想水深降至一百二十公尺，分別求底壓倍率與同寬合力倍率，再說明為何不能以壓力變化百分比直接代表整體水推力變化。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Reduce hypothetical depth to one hundred twenty metres, calculate bottom-pressure and fixed-width force ratios, and explain why the percentage pressure change cannot directly represent the change in total water thrust.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：直接拿一百八十公尺壩高代入每次水壓計算會忽略實際水位；把兆帕數字當作兆牛頓則漏掉面積，讓看似相近的數字實際代表完全不同的物理量。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Substituting structural height for every pressure calculation ignores changing water level. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用壓力三角形區分底壓與平均壓，再選一個投影寬度求合力以確認單位不同。核對壓力感測器是絕對壓還是表壓，並將安裝高程與水面高程分開記錄，避免基準錯置。
knowledge.textEn: Use a pressure triangle to separate bottom and mean pressures, then select a projected width to obtain force and check units. Identify absolute versus gauge pressure sensors and record installation and water-surface elevations separately to prevent datum errors.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 把假想水深降至一百二十公尺，分別求底壓倍率與同寬合力倍率，再說明為何不能以壓力變化百分比直接代表整體水推力變化。
knowledge.textEn: Reduce hypothetical depth to one hundred twenty metres, calculate bottom-pressure and fixed-width force ratios, and explain why the percentage pressure change cannot directly represent the change in total water thrust.

quiz.question: 要驗證「高壩底壓與水推力」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Base pressure and water resultant"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
用壓力三角形區分底壓與平均壓，再選一個投影寬度求合力以確認單位不同。
只要取樣率高就可以恢復感測器已飽和的峰值
optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.
Use a pressure triangle to separate bottom and mean pressures, then select a projected width to obtain force and check units.
A high sampling rate can recover peaks already clipped by sensor saturation
quiz.explanation: 用壓力三角形區分底壓與平均壓，再選一個投影寬度求合力以確認單位不同。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Use a pressure triangle to separate bottom and mean pressures, then select a projected width to obtain force and check units. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 高壩底壓與水推力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Base pressure and water resultant: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「高壩底壓與水推力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Base pressure and water resultant” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 直接拿一百八十公尺壩高代入每次水壓計算會忽略實際水位；把兆帕數字當作兆牛頓則漏掉面積，讓看似相近的數字實際代表完全不同的物理量。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Substituting structural height for every pressure calculation ignores changing water level. Treating a megapascal value as meganewtons omits area and confuses quantities that may look numerically similar but have different physical meanings. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：水深應由自由水面量到計算點，不能直接把壩高當成每一時刻的有效水深，也不能忽略尾水反壓。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Depth is measured from the free surface to the point, not automatically equated with structural height, and downstream counterpressure must be considered when relevant.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「壩高就是任何水位下都應使用的靜水深度」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Structural dam height is the hydrostatic depth at every reservoir level" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 直接拿一百八十公尺壩高代入每次水壓計算會忽略實際水位；把兆帕數字當作兆牛頓則漏掉面積，讓看似相近的數字實際代表完全不同的物理量。
knowledge.textEn: Substituting structural height for every pressure calculation ignores changing water level. Treating a megapascal value as meganewtons omits area and confuses quantities that may look numerically similar but have different physical meanings.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「高壩底壓與水推力」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Base pressure and water resultant" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
兩岸同向等量平移必然造成跨距增加
直接拿一百八十公尺壩高代入每次水壓計算會忽略實際水位；把兆帕數字當作兆牛頓則漏掉面積，讓看似相近的數字實際代表完全不同的物理量。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Equal translation of both abutments in one direction necessarily increases span
Substituting structural height for every pressure calculation ignores changing water level.
quiz.explanation: 直接拿一百八十公尺壩高代入每次水壓計算會忽略實際水位；把兆帕數字當作兆牛頓則漏掉面積，讓看似相近的數字實際代表完全不同的物理量。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Substituting structural height for every pressure calculation ignores changing water level. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
